Class GameCharacter

java.lang.Object
ashen.model.GameCharacter
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class GameCharacter extends Object implements Serializable
Represents the playable character created by the user. Stores identity, selected equipment, ability scores, difficulty options and current combat health.
